observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a black DSLR body with 'Nikon' and 'D610' text visible on the front, lens mount cap in place, no lens attached.
Red grip accent strip shows visible wear/scuffing on the right-hand grip.
Photo 2 shows the top plate: LCD panel displaying a '-3' exposure-type value, mode dial, and a hot-shoe that looks worn/tarnished with visible scratches and grime.
No lens is visible in any photo despite the seller's claim about lens condition.
No battery, charger, memory card, or shutter-count screen is shown in any photo.
Surface has dust/debris on the top plate near the hot shoe.

claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition, may show cosmetic wear
claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear on grip strip and hot shoe, consistent with cosmetic wear but 'good condition' functionally is unproven.
No shutter-count screenshot (e.g., via menu or software) shown in any photo.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No lens is visible in any of the 3 photos; body is shown with rear cap/mount cover on, lens not pictured.

claims.claim: Comes with original battery and charger
claims.evidence: No battery or charger shown in any photo.
No internal, service-sticker, or screw-tamper evidence shown; cannot be assessed from exterior photos.

risks.risk: Actual shutter count could be far higher than claimed, affecting sensor/shutter life and price
risks.proof: Photo or screen capture of the shutter count from Nikon menu or a shutter-count checker tool/website
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-mileage/unknown shutter count, i.e. worst case

risks.risk: No lens is included despite lens-condition claims, so buyer may need to source a lens separately
risks.proof: A photo showing the actual lens that comes with the sale, or explicit confirmation the sale is body-only
risks.if_unproven: priced as body-only, no lens included

risks.risk: Battery and charger may not be original or may be missing/faulty
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger, including Nikon branding/model markings
risks.if_unproven: priced as if battery/charger not included or generic

risks.risk: Hot shoe appears worn/corroded, which could indicate flash/accessory connectivity issues
risks.proof: Close-up photo or video of the hot shoe contacts and a test with a flash unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as hot shoe potentially non-functional

risks.risk: LCD display shows an unusual reading ('-3'), which could indicate a functional quirk or exposure compensation left engaged, or could hint at a deeper fault
risks.proof: Video of the camera powering on, taking a test shot, and displaying normal exposure/settings
risks.if_unproven: priced as camera with unverified functional status, i.e. worst case (not confirmed working)

risks.risk: General sensor, autofocus, and shutter mechanical health cannot be verified from static photos
risks.proof: A short video of the camera powering on, firing the shutter at various speeds, and a test photo showing focus/image quality

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and firing the shutter, with a visible shutter count reading from the menu
Photo of the actual lens (if any) being sold with the camera, including glass close-up for fungus/scratches
Photo of the battery and charger included in the sale, showing Nikon branding
Close-up photo/video of the hot shoe and a flash test
Photo of a test image taken with the camera to confirm sensor/image quality
response.reason: The body is identifiable as a Nikon D610 from the front-panel text, but all key value claims (shutter count, lens condition, battery/charger, repair history, functional status) are unverifiable from the photos alone, and no lens is shown despite lens claims; it must be priced as a worn, unverified-functioning, body-only unit.
